T: No sun on Jackson's Star. Plenty of gravy.
D: A crew of young colonists sneak aboard an abandoned space station to steal the cryo pods that could get them off their mining world.
P: Serve the snacks when Rain hears her contract hours have gone up again.
S: packed for a double shift in the mine, still warm at the end of it

Finely dice 350g beef skirt steak, 1 potato, 150g swede and 1 onion and season hard with salt and pepper. Cut 4 rounds from 3 sheets shortcrust pastry, pile on the filling, dot with 20g butter, fold and crimp. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then 170C for 30 minutes. Rest 5 minutes.
salt and plenty of black pepper@Pantry
he has a joke for everything, and every one of them is corny

Cut the kernels from 3 corn cobs. Whisk 1 egg, 80ml milk, 75g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and salt, then fold in the corn, 2 sliced spring onions and a handful of chopped coriander. Fry spoonfuls in oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Serve with 125g sour cream mixed with the zest and juice of 1 lime.
M: Jackson's Star never-sunrise beef and barley stew
the colony never sees the sun, so dinner has to warm you instead

Toss 800g diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches in 2 tbsp oil. Soften 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 2 garlic cloves, stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, add 1.2 litres beef stock, 2 bay leaves and 1 tsp dried thyme and simmer covered for 1 hour. Add 100g pearl barley and simmer 40 minutes more. Season, scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.
hot food at last, aboard the drifting station

Panko chicken with a sweet Japanese curry sauce, steamed rice and pickled cucumber. Fry the chopped onion and carrots in 1 tbsp of the oil for 8 minutes, stir in 2 tbsp of the flour and the curry powder, then add the stock, soy and honey and simmer for 10 minutes. Blend smooth. Simmer the rice with 450ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5. Slice the cucumber thinly and toss with the rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar. Slice each breast in half through the middle. Dip in the rest of the flour, then beaten egg, then panko. Shallow fry in the rest of the oil for 3 minutes a side until golden, then slice. Serve the chicken over rice with the curry sauce poured alongside and the cucumber.
W: a slice of sunlight for Rain, nine years before she sees the real thing

Cream 175g butter and 175g caster sugar, beat in 3 eggs and the zest of 2 lemons, then fold in 175g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp milk. Bake in a lined loaf tin at 180C for 45 minutes. Mix the juice of 3 lemons with 100g caster sugar, prick the hot cake all over and pour the drizzle on. Cool in the tin.
K: as cold as the cryo pods they came up to steal
Simmer 100g caster sugar in 125ml water until dissolved and cool. Blend with the juice of 4 limes and 3 cups ice until slushy. Pour into 4 glasses, top with a splash of soda water and a mint sprig.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and crimp the pasties up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled, or freeze raw up to 1 month; bake on the night

ingredients.item: salt and plenty of black pepper, to taste

steps.text: Dice the steak, potato, swede and onion small and evenly.
Mix together and season hard with salt and pepper.
Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 4 large rounds from the pastry, pile the filling on one half of each, dot with the butter, fold over and crimp the edge.
Brush with the egg, cut a small steam hole and bake for 15 minutes, then turn the oven down to 170C and bake 30 minutes more.
Rest before serving.

steps.text: Dice the mushrooms, potato, swede and onion small and evenly.
Mix with the cheddar and season hard with salt and pepper.
Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 4 large rounds from the pastry, pile the filling on one half of each, dot with the butter, fold over and crimp the edge.
Brush with the egg, cut a small steam hole and bake for 15 minutes, then turn the oven down to 170C and bake 30 minutes more.
Rest before serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the lime sour cream up to 2 days ahead; fry the fritters just before serving, the batter can wait 2 hours in the fridge

steps.text: Stand each cob on its end and cut off the kernels.
Whisk the egg, milk, flour, baking powder and a good pinch of salt and pepper into a thick batter.
Fold in the corn, spring onions and most of the coriander.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry heaped spoonfuls for 3 minutes a side, in batches, until golden. Drain on paper towel.
Mix the sour cream with the lime zest and juice, scatter the rest of the coriander over the fritters and serve.

dishes.n: Jackson's Star never-sunrise beef and barley stew
dishes.make_ahead: Make the stew up to 3 days ahead and keep chilled, it gets better; loosen with a splash of water when you reheat

steps.text: Toss the beef in the flour with salt and pepper. Dice the onion, carrots and celery and crush the garlic.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef well in batches. Lift out.
Soften the onion, carrots, celery and garlic in the same pot.
Stir in the tomato paste, return the beef, add the stock, bay leaves and thyme and simmer, covered, on low.
Stir in the barley and simmer, uncovered, until the barley is tender and the gravy thick.
Season, scatter with parsley and serve with torn crusty bread.

veg.n: Jackson's Star never-sunrise mushroom and barley stew
veg.make_ahead: Make the stew up to 3 days ahead and keep chilled; loosen with a splash of water when you reheat

steps.text: Dice the onion, carrots and celery and crush the garlic.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot and fry the mushrooms hard in batches until browned. Lift out.
Soften the onion, carrots, celery and garlic in the same pot, then stir in the flour and tomato paste.
Return the mushrooms, add the stock, soy sauce, beans, bay leaves, thyme and barley and simmer, partly covered, until the barley is tender and the gravy thick.
Season, scatter with parsley and serve with torn crusty bread.

Slice the cucumber thinly and toss with the rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar.
Slice each breast in half through the middle. Dip in the rest of the flour, then beaten egg, then panko.
Shallow fry in the rest of the oil for 3 minutes a side until golden, then slice.

veg.make_ahead: Make the curry sauce up to 2 days ahead and reheat; crumb the pumpkin up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the chopped onion and carrots in 1 tbsp of the oil for 8 minutes, stir in 2 tbsp of the flour and the curry powder, then add the stock, soy and honey and simmer for 10 minutes. Blend smooth.
Simmer the rice with 450ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5.
Slice the cucumber thinly and toss with the rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar.
Cut the peeled pumpkin into 1cm slices. Dip in the rest of the flour, then beaten egg, then panko.
Shallow fry in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes a side until golden and tender.
Serve over rice with the curry sauce poured alongside and the cucumber.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 2 days ahead and keep airtight; it gets stickier and better

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C and line a loaf tin with baking paper.
Beat the butter and cake sugar until pale and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time with the zest of 2 lemons, then fold in the flour and milk.
Spoon into the tin and bake until risen and a skewer comes out clean.
Mix the juice of all 3 lemons with the drizzle sugar.
Prick the hot cake all over with a skewer, pour over the drizzle and leave to cool in the tin.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and chill the lime syrup up to 1 week ahead; blend with the ice just before serving

steps.text: Simmer the sugar and water until dissolved.
Cool the syrup completely.
Blend the syrup, lime juice and ice until slushy.
Pour into 4 glasses, top with soda water and add a mint sprig.
